title: East Maui water board budget and staffing requests
summary: In November 2024 the director proposed adding a water resource specialist and a half-time intern, plus money for watershed programs, a strategic plan and outside lawyers, ahead of the mayor's budget and council review. In 2026 a finance committee idea was floated for a future agenda, and the director planned to bring next year's budget to the board in October.

timeline.text: The director will bring the next year's budget to the board at its October meeting.
The director's idea of a finance committee could be put on next month's agenda.
The request also adds money for watershed programs, a strategic plan, and special counsel (outside lawyers).
The director proposed two new positions in the budget: a water resource specialist and a half-time intern.
Taking item 5A out of order: With no objection, the board agreed to take up the budget request, item 5A, right after public testimony.
